text:
elaine: Quick note: on onboard canary for terns-v1-int8 I’m seeing tool_call responses where the tools array contains a single item with name=="" (empty string). downstream parser throws when accessing name.

sam: repro: prompt "Fetch weather for SF" -> response: {"type":"tool_call","tools":[{"name":"","args":{}}]}

toby: frequency ~2.5% in a 200-sample run. local logs show occasional sequences of null-ish tokens around the name. maybe token id 0 slide.

elaine: mitigation options: 1) validator reject empty-name tool objects and soft-retry; 2) router fallback to fp16 model for those responses; 3) tolerant parser that ignores entries without valid name and emits telemetry.

sam: I pushed a tiny router patch to soft-retry once with prompt: "Please re-output the tool_call and ensure each tool has a non-empty name string." Can run 1k quick calls now.

ops-bot: Patch deployed to 15% for terns-v1-int8 canary. Alert rule created: toolcall.invalid_name.rate > 10/m -> auto-fallback.

elaine: after hotfix 1k calls -> invalid-name drops to 0.9%. still need kernel triage. I’ll attach token dumps for failing cases to the issue.

toby: filing issue RW-ml/3387: include steps: add schema rule (non-empty name), onboarding smoke test for funcalls, retain raw token streams for 24h on failures, kernel bisect across int8 variants. assigning sam+infra.

elaine: thanks — adding eval vectors with varied punctuation and quoted tool names to stress tokenizer. :memo:
